name: free-accordion/accordion
title: Free Accordion group
description: Defines an accordion group. Child items link to this block via their parent group setting

groupId.description: Copy of the Gutenberg clientId, persisted to be available in PHP

label.description: Readable label to identify this group in the editor

exclusive.description: If true, opening an item closes the sibling items in the same group

animated.description: If true, opening/closing is animated in CSS (max-height)

globalControl.description: If true, the buttons in this group control all accordions on the page
